# YouTube Video Downloader

The Apify actor [`streamers/youtube-video-downloader`](https://apify.com/streamers/youtube-video-downloader) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.111**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Use YouTube Video Downloader to download YouTube videos in MP4, MP3, avi, and other formats directly to your cloud storage service.  Just add a YouTube video URL and get the converted video in a few seconds.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Video download of 1MB $0.006, Add-on: transcript $0.048 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/streamers/youtube-video-downloader) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/streamers-youtube-video-downloader@0.0.111#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      videos: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ` note` | string \| null | Optional warning about storage link expiry or other important notes visible at the top of the output |
| `id` | string \| null | ID of the downloaded video |
| `input` | string \| null | Original input URL that was processed |
| `downloadedFileUrl` | string \| null | URL of the merged video+audio file uploaded to storage. Null if no storage was configured or upload failed. |
| `fileKey` | string \| null | Storage key or object path under which the merged file was stored. Null if no storage was configured. |
| `audioOnlyUrl` | string \| null | Direct URL to the best-quality audio-only stream. May be undefined if the video has no separate audio track. |
| `videoOnlyUrl` | string \| null | Direct URL to the best-quality video-only stream (or combined stream if no separate tracks are available) |
